published_10_80_min.notes: Quick web lookup. 25 min 10–80 % from one spec block that does not name the trim (assumed Performance).

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: 78.1 kWh nominal, LG 5L NMC (EV Database); Wikipedia lists 78.1 kWh for Premium RWD/AWD. EV Database Highland Performance page covers Apr 2024-Oct 2025 (78.1/75). SPLIT NEEDED: EV Database lists the Oct 2025+ European Performance at 82.0/79.0 kWh (LG 5M, https://ev-database.org/car/3841/Tesla-Model-3-Performance), and the existing OpenEV import on 2026/performance-awd shows 82/79; US KBB (2026) still lists 75 kWh. This powertrain spans 2024-2027 so one value is shown here.

preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Tesla's release note (2020.24.6.4, Model S/3/X/Y) says the car preconditions its battery when navigating to a fast charger; this is a software feature delivered to the whole Model 3 line (2024-2027 Performance). Page mentions no manual battery-warming control. A manual control was neither found nor ruled out: Tesla's owner's manual pages were blocked (403) and scheduled-departure preconditioning in search excerpts is cabin-oriented.
